verdict.rationale: ADK documents code-first agent definition in a few lines (an Agent with name, model, instruction and a tools list) and supports custom functions as tools defined directly in Python. However, the only snippet uses a prebuilt tool (google_search), and nothing shows how custom tool signatures are typed or turned into schemas. Missing for 10: evidence of typed tool definitions (type hints or schema generation from function signatures), a concrete custom-tool code example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define an agent with typed custom tools in a few lines of code

citations.quote:
agent = Agent(
    name="researcher",
    model="gemini-flash-latest",
    instruction="You help users research topics thoroughly.",
    tools=[google_search],
)
Utilize pre-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, MCP tools or integrate existing tools to give agents diverse capabilities
Define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for ultimate flexibility, testability, and versioning.
